title: 🚨 Ripple XRP: the shift is here (XRP is Infrastructure says Bitwise) 🚨
description:
Ripple RLUSD Stablecoin Gains Massive Cross-Chain Power with Wanchain Bridge | PACE Act Fed Access Bill + Bitwise XRP ETF Update

Ripple’s RLUSD stablecoin just leveled up big time. Wanchain added full bridge support, enabling seamless RLUSD transfers between XRPL, Ethereum, Cardano, and Wanchain networks. This major interoperability upgrade reduces CEX dependency and supercharges DeFi, payments, and cross-chain liquidity for the $1.5 billion stablecoin.
In this episode:

Full details on new RLUSD bridge routes (XRPL ↔ Cardano/Ethereum/Wanchain, direct XRPL-Ethereum via Wanchain, and more)

Why this fits Ripple’s multichain strategy including Wormhole L2 expansion
Latest RLUSD momentum: Coinone listing, Bitrue futures collateral, Mastercard settlement talks

Story 2: PACE Act Introduced
Bipartisan bill by California reps would give Ripple, Circle, and other nonbanks direct access to Fedwire, FedNow, and FedACH. How the PACE Act could shortcut Ripple’s master account approval from years to ~360 days with hard deadlines — and what it means for faster, cheaper RLUSD and XRP Ledger settlements.

Story 3: Bitwise Shifts XRP Narrative
Bitwise Asset Management now calls XRP “financial plumbing” and established fintech infrastructure for cross-border payments, remittances, and stablecoin settlement. Massive institutional inflows into U.S. spot XRP ETFs, $1.5B+ AUM, Goldman Sachs, Citadel, Millennium, ARK, and more piling in as XRP hits new highs in adoption.

🚀 JOIN THE JUNGLE INC COMMUNITY
The digital asset landscape is moving fast. Subscribe to stay updated on the institutional adoption of the XRP Ledger and the evolution of global liquidity.

🎯 PROFESSIONAL CRYPTO ANALYSIS
As an Enrolled Agent (EA) and dedicated content creator since 2018, I provide high-level analysis on the intersection of traditional finance and Web3. My coverage focuses on:

XRP & Ripple: Utility, legal developments, and global payment rails.

Layer 1 Infrastructure: Real-world asset (RWA) tokenization, DeFi, and scaling on Ethereum, Cardano, and Polkadot.

Macro Trends: Regulation, market cycles, and institutional capital flows.

⚠️ DISCLAIMER
This video contains news commentary and analysis intended for informational and educational purposes only. I am not a financial advisor. I am an Enrolled Agent, but the views expressed here are my personal opinions and do not constitute professional tax or investment advice. Cryptocurrency markets are highly volatile; always conduct your own research. Past performance is not indicative of future results.
